title: Beatrice Abenteuer
author: Loginloolzocker
selftext:
Hi everyone 👋,

You are really diligent and have been checking out my little 'Beatric Adventure' quite a lot! I’m very happy about that! In the meantime, the aforementioned nitrous oxide canisters have been filled, and the game is ready, so I wanted to share it with you again. I hope you enjoy it! Please let me know if you notice anything or if anything bothers you!

And YES, this thing is international!

German, English, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, French, as well as Spanish – I hope I’ve covered the most important languages with this.

Have fun!

You can find the game here:

https://claude.ai/public/artifacts/bdac50e7-d305-4d62-9dbe-9f6de08ca9e4
